results.title: non-listed requester / result forgery
results.expected: request rejected; socket cannot be replaced
results.observed: reply: error (requester is not authorised); unlink PermissionError; create PermissionError

results.title: kill provd, then inject
results.expected: consent fails closed (injection allowed as in baseline)
results.observed: provd: dead; attacker: created 9335; wrote; prompt: error

result.reason: connecting to /run/prove/consent.sock (is provd running?): Connection refused (os error 111)

results.expected: replacement impossible; writable entry rejected
results.observed: user replace: blocked; writable entry: rejected; its use: created 3; wrote
